description: Extend an image to a new size by outpainting (Ideogram 3.0 or Nano Banana 2). Results are saved to the output directory; ideogram_quote prices a call first (nothing is generated).

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio such as 16x9; not with resolution

color_palette.description: A preset palette by name, or explicit hex colours with weights

image.description: Local image file to work on, or a public https URL of one

image_asset_identifier.description: An Ideogram asset (an upload or an earlier result) instead of a local image

inline_images.description: true: each saved image is also returned as image content (base64; one over 3.75 MB, or past 10 MB in total, by path only), for a client without file access

model.description: The model (default ideogram-3); each takes the fields of its variant below

num_images.description: How many images to make (each is billed)

private.description: Keep the result out of Ideogram's public feed; true unless you set false (enterprise accounts are always private)

rendering_speed.description: turbo, default or quality: faster is cheaper

resolution.description: Exact output size WIDTHxHEIGHT from the model's list; not with aspect_ratio

seed.description: Random seed for a reproducible result

style_preset.description: A named style preset; not with style codes or style references

style_reference_asset_identifiers.description: Ideogram assets (uploads or earlier results) to use as style references

style_reference_images.description: Local image files (or public https URLs) whose style the result follows

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the result (0-50, default 45). The job is accepted first; if it is still running when the wait ends, the result is its generation_id for ideogram_generation (never resubmitted, never billed twice).

name: ideogram_reframe
title: Reframe an image
